label: Bible Study
prompt: And when he had spoken these things, while they beheld, he was taken up; and a _____ received him out of their sight.
verse: And when he had spoken these things, while they beheld, he was taken up; and a cloud received him out of their sight.
note: The ascension — Jesus taken up while they watched, and a cloud closed the view.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: Thou hast enlarged my steps under me; so that my feet did not _____.
verse: Thou hast enlarged my steps under me; so that my feet did not slip.
note: God widened the path under David's steps so his feet would not slip.

label: Sunday School
prompt: Above it stood the seraphims: each one had six _____; with twain he covered his face, and with twain he covered his feet, and with twain he did fly.
verse: Above it stood the seraphims: each one had six wings; with twain he covered his face, and with twain he covered his feet, and with twain he did fly.
note: Each seraph had six wings: two to cover the face, two the feet, and two to fly — reverence takes most of them.

label: Deep Water
prompt: And he did that which was right in the sight of the LORD, and walked in the ways of David his father, and _____ neither to the right hand, nor to the left.
verse: And he did that which was right in the sight of the LORD, and walked in the ways of David his father, and declined neither to the right hand, nor to the left.
note: Josiah became king at eight and never veered — right or left — from David's path.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: It is like the precious _____ upon the head, that ran down upon the beard, even Aaron's beard: that went down to the skirts of his garments;
verse: It is like the precious ointment upon the head, that ran down upon the beard, even Aaron's beard: that went down to the skirts of his garments;
note: Unity is like anointing oil on Aaron's head, running down his beard to his robe — fragrant, generous, holy.
